Variation: Depending upon the size that your product is available in please select the relevant size and fill in the necessary information. Example: Clothing comes in XS, S, M,L,XL,XXL etc according to body type Footwear comes in 37, 38, 39 according to foot size Beddings come in king, queen or single according to bed size, etc. If the relevant size for your product is not available in the drop down, please select Free Size.
HSN: Select the HSN ID from the dropdown.
Country of Origin: Country of Origin means the country in which the product has been produced/assembled. This information is available on the packaging label for pre- packed products. If you are not listing a pre-packed product, please provide the country in which the product is manufactured.
Generic Name: Generic Name means the commonly used name through which a product is generally called/known. Generic name DOES NOT MEAN the name of the brand or manufacturer of the product or its use.
Net Quantity:
Net Quantity means total number of units in the product. If the product is a multi- pack, please mention the total number of units in the multi-pack. 

For example- if you are selling t-shirts in a multi-pack of 4, please specify 4.
Print or Pattern Type: Select "Print or Pattern Type" from the list
Blouse Length Size: Select "Blouse Length Size" from the list (Meter)
Saree Length Size: Select "Saree Length Size" from the list (Meter)
Group ID: Enter same group ID for the products which should be grouped in a single catalog on Meesho app.
